caption: The drawing displays two main objects: a wooden chair and a partial close-up view of its decorative back and top rail. The chair has four legs, with the back legs slightly curved and the front legs straight, connected by horizontal stretchers for stability. The seat, backrest, and legs are all predominantly brown, with painted decorative accents in green and dull red. The top rail, back splat, and seat feature hand-painted motifs, including green foliage and pink-red floral elements, providing an ornamental design. Beside the chair, there is an enlarged, detailed view of the backrest’s decoration, highlighting three pink-red floral shapes surrounded by green leaves against the brown wood. The background is neutral, and the entire composition is rendered with precise outlines and shading to emphasize the texture and color contrast between the natural wood and painted decorations.
title: Pa. German Chair
